verdict.rationale: Docs confirm both public and private channels exist (zulip-docs-14, zulip-docs-22) with subscription-based membership, and guests are restricted from public channels by default, implying granular membership rules. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of admin-side controls like inviting/removing members, changing channel privacy settings, or role-based channel permissions. missing for 10: explicit admin membership management docs, channel privacy/permission settings, independent corroboration of admin controls in practice.
